text: In 2006, scientists trapped a few crows for a study.
One of them wore a caveman mask.
For the next 17 years, anyone in that mask got screamed at and dive-bombed on sight.
Crows that were never trapped joined in.
They learned the hate by watching.
Then they taught it to their babies.
The scientists tested a second mask to compare.
The crows were completely fine with Dick Cheney.
The feud only ended in 2023, after the last crow from 2006 died.
So if a crow is staring at you right now...
